entries.headline: Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle announced, trailer set for November 10
entries.summary: Square Enix announced Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle, a command-based RPG for smartphones. An approximately two-minute announcement trailer will premiere on YouTube at 8:00 PM JST on November 10. The packet does not yet establish gameplay details or a release date.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Square Enix's announcement and confirms the title, smartphone command-RPG positioning and trailer premiere time.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON report was published on November 9 at 11:09 AM Beijing time; the trailer is scheduled for November 10 at 8:00 PM JST.

entries.headline: Beholder 4 announced with a double-agent role inside the government
entries.summary: Alawar announced Beholder 4 for the series' 10th anniversary. The PC game casts the player as a government ministry employee who secretly assists an underground organization, with actions including eavesdropping, document forgery, lockpicking and planting bugs. A release date has not been announced.
entries.verification: The opened Denfaminicogamer report explicitly relays Alawar's announcement and confirms the title, PC platform, double-agent premise and unannounced release date.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 10 at 6:28 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Minecraft Realms adds a Pro plan supporting up to 50 concurrent players
entries.summary: Mojang Studios announced a Realms Pro plan for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. It provides a four-core CPU, 16 GB of RAM, 25 GB of save storage and support for up to 50 concurrent players. The plan costs 4,730 yen per month in Japan, with a 220-yen introductory price for the first 14 days; device performance can still limit the practical player count.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Mojang Studios' announcement and lists the plan's capacity, player limit, pricing, supported edition and device-performance caveat.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 10 at 9:46 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever sets franchise launch records for concurrency and returning players
entries.summary: Blizzard said World of Warcraft: Forever delivered the highest peak concurrent-player count and the most returning players of any World of Warcraft launch. Executive producer Holly Longdale added that it also attracted the most new players for a WoW launch in 15 years. The report does not provide exact player counts.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report explicitly relays public statements from the official World of Warcraft account and executive producer Holly Longdale; the packet contains no exact player totals.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 10 at 3:27 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Super Mario Party Jamboree version 2.4.0 adds GameShare through GameChat on Switch 2
entries.summary: Nintendo released version 2.4.0 of Super Mario Party Jamboree. When playing Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV, users can now access GameShare through GameChat. The update also contains other changes for the Switch 2 and Switch versions.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays Nintendo's patch notes and confirms version 2.4.0, GameShare, GameChat and the applicable Switch 2 edition.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 10 at 10:00 AM Beijing time.

entries.headline: El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi adds online play and launches on Steam
entries.summary: crim released a major update for El Shaddai: Zero Nine Reversi, adding an online mode for up to four players, and launched a Steam version. The update gives the existing mobile release and the new PC version a multiplayer entry point.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report explicitly relays crim's announcement and confirms the major update, up-to-four-player online mode and Steam launch.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 9 at 2:43 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Path of Exile 2 announces the Shadow class and Conquerors of Wraeclast league
entries.summary: Grinding Gear Games announced the Shadow class and the Conquerors of Wraeclast league for Path of Exile 2 at ExileCon 2026. The new content also introduces siege battles in which players lead their own forces. The packet does not establish a release date.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report explicitly relays Grinding Gear Games' ExileCon 2026 announcement and confirms the class, league and siege-battle content.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 9 at 5:12 PM Beijing time.
